kind: independent additive continuation source and pure guard review
review_conclusions: Only execution selections/fingerprints gain additive treatment. Every original selection and full original fingerprint must remain exactly equal; no removal, mode change, missing fingerprint, reselected identity or changed original bytes is allowed.

Semantic source definitions, evaluated input bindings and acceptance allocations remain exactly equal. prepare_inventory recomputes actual added fingerprints and requires complete named owner review/rationale; continuation requires owner review after attempt capture plus independently validated fresh runtime observation.

capture_continuation requires exact current original run and owned check results, unchanged original authority/plan/baseline/scope, a distinct run identity and preserved attempt history. Candidate is a deep copy; every owned check is reset to not_run with old execution fields removed and findings retained.

validate_context and validate_transition recheck the continuation against immutable prior attempts, original source snapshots and bindings. Existing evidence and failed results cannot become current passes; completion still needs fresh checks/runtime/input observations.

Adding a file inside an originally selected tree changes its fingerprint and therefore correctly fails this explicit additive-only contract; new executor paths must preserve all old tree memberships as well as bytes.

New tests exercise actual capture/transition/reset/history preservation through the existing fixture, and negative changed-original-file/mode/removal paths. Their runtime fixture execution was source-reviewed but not run by this reviewer.
